verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents a real MCP server (jitsu-docs-19/46/48/63) and Management API/OpenAPI (jitsu-docs-47/61) that let an agent configure destinations, streams, and Functions headlessly, and it has a Profile Builder that creates customer profile records in the warehouse (jitsu-docs-11/12/28/39/53) queryable via SQL (jitsu-docs-43). But there is no documented API/MCP capability for defining or activating 'audiences' (segments) or pushing them to activation destinations — profiles are just warehouse tables, and audience-style filtering is only mentioned informally via pricing-page Functions filtering (jitsu-docs-45), not as an agent-callable audience-activation endpoint. missing for 10: explicit audience/segment creation and activation API or MCP tool, evidence of an agent querying/segmenting customer profiles end-to-end without dashboard, independent confirmation of the Management API's OpenAPI reference (probe found 404s on standard OpenAPI paths).
